notes.title: Demo update v1.0.0c
notes.content: [p]A minor demo update to fix some stuff. Version [b]1.0.0c[/b] changes the following:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] challenge "Laser Run I" is now working - previously players could not start this challenge due to some missing content in demo[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tweak:[/b] reduced Infernal Skeleton Max HP from 100 to 75 - they can appear on first level and were a bit too difficult for new players[/p][/*][*][p][b]Content:[/b] added "Liquid Speed" Artifact to the content available in demo[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo is now available to download!
notes.content: [h1]Demo is OUT![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697432/a64543106c2bd0251f3428946de5d9fcd60a5c34.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey there, long time no see ^^[/p][p]Today the official (and new) version of Roll The Bones demo is out! Try the game out before it's release in Q4 2025.[/p][p]What's waiting for you?[/p][list][*][p]F-Rank [b]Training Gate[/b] to get you up to speed on spellcasting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rat King's Lair[/b] - first full D-Rank gate featuring 6 floors and a boss battle[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 Challenge Gates[/b] differing in difficulty levels - from D-rank to A-rank[/p][/*][*][p]Handpicked selection of [b]21 unique[/b] [b]Spell-Dice[/b] and [b]8[/b] [b]Artifacts[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44697432/1bc2333b7cbab7a47d114d8956222bbfa198a544.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]So what to expect in full version?[/h2][p]More content. Way more.[/p][p]Full game will feature:[/p][list][*][p]several, multi-floor dungeon gates, each with a unique boss and different selection of enemies[/p][/*][*][p]a ton of challenge gates requiring different skills to complete them[/p][/*][*][p]more Spell-Dice and Artifacts - demo is just a small selection of what's to come[/p][/*][*][p]different playable characters and character skins[/p][/*][/list][h2]Time to play[/h2][p]Download the demo from Steam page, play a bit and join my Discord ([url="https://discord.gg/rnuNPCnGDK"]https://discord.gg/rnuNPCnGDK[/url]) to leave some feedback! I'm always listening for suggestions :D[/p][p]Also please drop a wishlist for the game on it's Steam page if you're interested in the full release - it helps a ton![/p][p][/p][p][i]~Shrimp[/i][/p]
